description: Production électrique par filière pour la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Enedis. Le jeu de données restitue la production électrique annuelle totale et le nombre de sites, par "filière" et par "domaine de tension et de puissance" à la maille EPCI sur le réseau géré par Enedis. Les données présentées débutent à l'année 2011. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Production électrique, domaine de tension, puissance. The portal shows 39 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2018-11-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
